text:
maria: Just merged PR #5421 (token-cache tweak). CI on main just went red — smoke/gpu-smoke failing. @jonathan @tasha can someone grab quick eyeballs? :eyes:
ci-bot: :x: Build failed — pipeline https://ci.example.com/build/6843210000
ci-bot: Failed step: `gpu-smoke` (shard 3). Exit code 137, log snippet attached.
jonathan: grabbing logs now, pinging owners.
jonathan: log shows allocation failure in `kv_allocator.cc` around the heavy-batch test. snippet:
```
E 03:12:45 Allocator::alloc failed: requested=1.2G available=768M
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
#0 0x7f... kv_allocator::alloc()
```
tasha: hmm that looks aligned with the PR touching cache config. Maria, did the change bump the default batch/kv prefetch?
maria: yes small tweak to prefetch window in the PR, intended to reduce cold misses. I didn't expect this at smoke scale.
jonathan: I'm going to rerun the failing job with a smaller shard (shard=1) to see if it's data-distribution related.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by jonathan. Link: https://ci.example.com/build/6843210000/rerun/1
jonathan: rerun started — will report back in ~5m.
jonathan: rerun finished — still fails with same OOM on shard1.
oliver: tagging in — I own allocator area. I'm on a call atm, can check in ~20m. If we need hotfix sooner, recommend temporary revert of the prefetch tweak.
tasha: can we do a quick bisect across the last 5 merges? If the regression shows only with this PR, revert is safest.
maria: agree. @jonathan can you kick the bisect job? If it isolates to my PR I'll revert and open a safer patch.
jonathan: starting bisect job across commits [abc123..def789] now. Will post results.
ci-bot: Bisect job submitted: https://ci.example.com/bisect/6843210000 (jobs: 5).
jonathan: first two commits clear, third commit (the one from PR #5421) reproduces failure consistently.
tasha: ok confirmed. Maria, will you open revert PR? I can help land it if you need.
maria: opening revert now and adding notes — will link once created. Thanks for quick triage y'all. :raised_hands:
jonathan: once revert lands, I'll trigger a smoke build and keep an eye.
ci-bot: Rerun will be triggered on merge of revert PR.
oliver: I'll review the original patch later and propose a less aggressive prefetch default. For now revert is fine.
maria: revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5430 — tagged urgent.
jonathan: watching the pipeline. If anything else pops up I'll post here.
ci-bot: Reminder: if revert doesn't clear, escalate to oncall.
jonathan: update: revert merged, pipeline passed on smoke. Closing this thread after postmortem notes.
